name: Card
description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A container for a header, content and footer, like shadcn's Card. The card
  # owns the spacing: it stacks its parts with --card-spacing as gap and
  # vertical padding, and each part pads only its sides. size: :sm tightens
  # the spacing and the title; it is exposed as data-size for the parts.
  class Card < Base
    SIZES = %i[default sm].freeze

    def initialize(size: :default, **attrs)
      @size = size.to_s.to_sym
      @size = :default unless SIZES.include?(@size) # nil or unknown: default size
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card", size: @size},
        class: [
          # No overflow-hidden (vega has it): RubyUI popups such as Select and
          # Popover render inside the card, and clipping would hide them.
          "group/card flex flex-col gap-(--card-spacing) rounded-xl bg-card py-(--card-spacing) text-sm text-card-foreground shadow-xs ring-1 ring-foreground/10",
          "[--card-spacing:--spacing(6)] data-[size=sm]:[--card-spacing:--spacing(4)]",
          # An image as the first or last child runs to the card's edge.
          "has-[>img:first-child]:pt-0 *:[img:first-child]:rounded-t-xl *:[img:last-child]:rounded-b-xl"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Top-right slot of a CardHeader for a control (a button, a link). It spans
  # the title and description rows.
  class CardAction < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-action"},
        class: "col-start-2 row-span-2 row-start-1 self-start justify-self-end"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CardContent < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-content"},
        class: "px-(--card-spacing)"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CardDescription < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-description"},
        class: "text-sm text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CardFooter < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-footer"},
        class: "flex items-center rounded-b-xl px-(--card-spacing) [.border-t]:pt-(--card-spacing)"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Title and description in a grid; a CardAction takes a second column on
  # the right, spanning both rows.
  class CardHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-header"},
        class: [
          "group/card-header @container/card-header grid auto-rows-min items-start gap-1 rounded-t-xl px-(--card-spacing)",
          "has-data-[slot=card-action]:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] has-data-[slot=card-description]:grid-rows-[auto_auto]",
          "[.border-b]:pb-(--card-spacing)"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A div, as in shadcn: the card can't know its heading level. Wrap the text
  # in an h2/h3 when the title should be a heading.
  class CardTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "card-title"},
        class: "font-heading text-base leading-normal font-medium group-data-[size=sm]/card:text-sm"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Card

Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

## Usage

### Card with image

```ruby
Card(class: 'w-96') do
  CardHeader do
    CardTitle { 'You might like "RubyUI"' }
    CardDescription { "@joeldrapper" }
  end
  CardContent do
    AspectRatio(ratio: "16/9", class: "rounded-md overflow-hidden border") do
      img(
        alt: "Placeholder",
        class: "absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover",
        loading: "lazy",
        src: image_url('pattern.jpg')
      )
    end
  end
  CardFooter(class: 'justify-end gap-2') do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "See more" }
    Button(variant: :primary) { "Buy now" }
  end
end
```

### Card with full-width image

```ruby
Card(class: 'w-96') do
  img(
    alt: "Placeholder",
    class: "aspect-video w-full object-cover",
    loading: "lazy",
    src: image_url('pattern.jpg')
  )
  CardHeader do
    CardTitle { 'Introducing RubyUI' }
    CardDescription { "Kickstart your project today!" }
  end
  CardFooter(class: 'justify-end') do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Get started" }
  end
end
```

### Account balance

```ruby
Card(class: 'w-96') do
  CardHeader do
    div(class: 'w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 -rotate-6') do
      cash_icon
    end
  end
  CardContent(class: 'space-y-1') do
    CardDescription(class: 'font-medium') { "Current Balance" }
    h5(class: 'font-semibold text-4xl') { '$2,602' }
  end
  CardFooter do
    Text(size: "2", class: "text-muted-foreground") { "**** 4620" }
  end
end
```

### With action

```ruby
Card(class: 'w-96') do
  CardHeader do
    CardTitle { "Login to your account" }
    CardDescription { "Enter your email below to login to your account" }
    CardAction do
      Button(variant: :link) { "Sign up" }
    end
  end
  CardContent do
    div(class: "grid gap-2") do
      FormFieldLabel(for: "card-email") { "Email" }
      Input(id: "card-email", type: "email", placeholder: "m@example.com")
    end
  end
  CardFooter do
    Button(class: "w-full") { "Login" }
  end
end
```

### Small

```ruby
Card(size: :sm, class: 'w-80') do
  CardHeader do
    CardTitle { "Small card" }
    CardDescription { "size: :sm tightens the spacing and the title." }
  end
  CardContent do
    plain "Use it in dense layouts such as sidebars and grids."
  end
  CardFooter do
    Button(variant: :outline, size: :sm, class: "w-full") { "Action" }
  end
end
```
